author: codex:engineering
context: PO approved eight newly curated expectations, then requested the next step. Expectation acceptance does not authorize reading/running the cases or accepting future model outputs.
decision: Bind authorization to a complete frozen request, consume an exclusive durable claim before private preflight, and stop on the first failure without resume/retry. Verify raw cases and rubric before provider construction. Preserve original cases and external expectation approval; raw rubric bytes bind the assessment. Replay reconstructs saved artifacts without calls.

evidence.note: Reviewed implementation and 36 focused offline tests; first full suite passed before final rubric/stop-reason tightening, final full verification remains separate.

limitations: Local declarations do not authenticate human identity or independently observe remote service calls.
Selected source freeze is not complete environment/remote model reproducibility; immutable model identity, sampler, cost and resource telemetry remain unknown.
Abrupt interruption can leave uncertain remote work and incomplete receipts; exact request remains consumed.
Implementation and synthetic tests do not authorize real reserved access, qualify the model, promote defaults or complete stories.
summary: Opt-in request/authorization/report and external-approval assessment contracts separate permission, exact payload preflight, charged invocations, replay and human output judgments.
title: Executar reservado com autorização exata e consumo único
